name: numeric-check
description: Numeric check of a statistic claim: the judge parses what the citing sentence states (condition, metric, geography, reference year, the number as written and its unit) with an exact quote; a deterministic comparison against a pinned table source of the cited statistics report then classifies the claim (consistent, number absent or different, wrong geography, wrong edition, non-epidemiological).
unit: one marker occurrence of a statistics-report citation (an S3 locus)

claim.population: S3 loci, only when the protocol records verified table licensing

evidencePolicy.evidence: the citing sentence with the named work's marker, and the cited work's title and year
evidencePolicy.tables: the comparison reads a pinned table source outside the model call; tables are never sent

repair.scope: items without a valid output after the first call

requiredModel.served: pinned per analysis by the follow-up protocol (model.served)

deterministicRows.comparison: numeric-comparison@1 against a pinned table source (followup_numeric)

notes: Statistics-report tables are a pluggable, pinned dataset; licensed tables are read only after their licensing is verified, and the protocol drops S3 otherwise.
A parse takes the condition, geography and year from the citing sentence; the comparison numeric-comparison@1 is deterministic and runs outside the model call.
